name: Nagarjuna
role: Indian Mahayana Buddhist philosopher from the early 1st millenium CE
contribution: A philosopher and Mahāyāna Buddhist monk from South India, considered the founder of the Madhyamaka school.
legacy: This person was a philosopher and Mahāyāna Buddhist monk from South India, considered the founder of the Madhyamaka school.

checks.lead: Nāgārjuna (Sanskrit, from Nāga + Arjuna; Chn. Lóngshù 龍樹; Tib. Klu sgrub; c. 150 – c. 250 CE) was a philosopher and Mahāyāna Buddhist monk from South India, considered the founder of the Madhyamaka (Centrism, Middle Way) school.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
